goal: Design the Career OS Phase G assurance architecture as a two-loop (focused validation / full assurance) governance and test-contract architecture over the existing unmodified canonical assurance runtime. Architecture/governance/test only; no runtime, CI workflow, or verify_assurance_baseline.py implementation change.
acceptance_conditions: The report reviews the existing assurance runtime (scripts/verify_assurance_baseline.py's four phases and the nine mandatory Phase 2 coverage anchors) without modifying it.

The report defines a two-loop assurance architecture: FOCUSED VALIDATION / ITERATION DIAGNOSTIC (milestone-scoped, explicitly NON_AUTHORITATIVE, never grants freeze/commit/push/PR/merge authority) and FULL ASSURANCE (python scripts/verify_assurance_baseline.py, the sole promotion-authoritative local full-suite gate and the hosted CI command, unmodified).
No second canonical 'fast assurance' runner and no global slow-test exclusion list is created in this milestone.
Every mutation invalidates any previously inherited focused or full green result; full assurance is required again after the final mutation before freeze.
Focused validation may save iteration time before full assurance but never substitutes for full assurance at any promotion boundary.
If the changed causal surface includes milestone_run/controller logic, milestone_run_v1_test.py must be run directly in the focused loop even though it is slow.

No permanent wall-clock threshold or hardcoded global slow-test exclusion list is selected; the four tests observed >5s in this milestone's single-sample profiling are not hardcoded anywhere as globally excludable.
New tests continue to enter the authoritative full suite automatically through scripts/verify_assurance_baseline.py's existing fail-closed discovery; no opt-out mechanism is added.
The nine mandatory Phase 2 coverage anchors are not weakened, removed, or made optional.
Cursor's independent adversarial review of immutable reviewed bytes after full assurance, and hosted CI as additive confirmation of the exact reviewed head, are both preserved unchanged.

Observed local timing figures (compile 3.118s; 89 standalone tests total 416.406s; golden runner 1.248s; recomputed displayed-component sum ~420.772s; the profiling helper's printed ALL_TOTAL 418.172s is explicitly retired as invalid evidence because dt was shadowed inside the per-test loop; median standalone test 0.447s; milestone_run_v1_test.py 318.741s; posting_state_decision_wiring_v1_test.py 35.100s; career_os_state_v1_test.py 15.247s; source_semantic_role_qualification_view_v1_test.py 5.089s; 10 tests >1s; 4 tests >5s) are labeled observed single-sample local diagnostic evidence, never an SLA or production reliability claim.

The hosted GitHub Actions run 34915038186 (~47s verify job, head 3dd762e26edf9d4cf194ae70f65c08cafdb6f0a0) is used only to demonstrate that local runtime is environment-sensitive, never as a correctness or reliability comparison.
milestone_run_v1_test.py is preserved unchanged as consequential controller/state-machine meta-integration coverage; it is not deleted, weakened, or globally excluded.

Recommendations A (timing observability), B (bounded optimization if repeated evidence justifies it), and C (a named NON_AUTHORITATIVE_FOCUSED_DIAGNOSTIC command only after A/B, never emitting the canonical full-success terminal message) are recorded as ranked Phase H recommendations only, not implemented or authorized here.

No parallel test execution, sharding, cache-based skipping, pytest/framework migration for speed alone, deletion/weakening of milestone_run_v1_test.py, mutable fast allowlist/denylist, or second CI workflow bypassing the canonical full command is selected.
No database, UI, vendor, storage engine, orchestration runtime, provider abstraction, new agent, model router, or LLM judge is selected or implemented.
No Phase D taxonomy, Phase E case corpus, or Phase F conceptual run-trace/phase-contract architecture is re-adjudicated or mutated.

Phase G completes only as COMPLETED_BY_OPERATOR / PENDING_BORA_ACCEPTANCE / READ_ONLY_DESIGN_ONLY with implementation_authorized=false; Phase H and every later roadmap phase remain PROPOSED_NOT_AUTHORIZED.
The exact next seam after a reviewed and merged Phase G completion is Bora acceptance/correction of Phase G; acceptance itself does not implicitly authorize Phase H or implementation.
Cursor independent adversarial review is required on the frozen exact diff before commit/push/PR; Cursor may not repair its own findings.
stop_conditions: Stop if completing the architecture requires modifying scripts/verify_assurance_baseline.py, any .github/workflows file, or any path outside allowed_paths.

Stop if the design would require creating a second canonical full-suite command, a global slow-test exclusion list, or a mutable fast allowlist/denylist whose green status could be mistaken for promotion assurance.
Stop if a database, UI, vendor, storage engine, provider abstraction, model router, new agent, LLM judge, or orchestration implementation would need to be selected.
Stop if the design would weaken, remove, delete, or globally exclude milestone_run_v1_test.py or any mandatory Phase 2 coverage anchor.
Stop if a proposed focused-loop test-selection rule is based on a permanent wall-clock threshold rather than causal relevance to the changed surface.

Stop if Phase G architecture would alter Phase D's accepted failure taxonomy, Phase E's accepted 15-case eval-set substance, or Phase F's accepted run-trace/phase-contract architecture rather than consuming them as context only.
Stop at Bora human acceptance/correction gate after a reviewed/merged Phase G completion; do not authorize Phase H or implementation implicitly.
